BL-760 — BL-727 forked into two live parcel chains under two task names, and nothing mechanical noticed
What it solves: Specifier 2026-07-31: IR-DRY reports six medium-confidence findings on the
feature file; all six reviewed and kept deliberately. Four are the outline's
parameterised steps substituting to exactly the literal steps used by the
standalone scenarios (`<sent task>`/`<mailbox>`/`<held task>`/`<outcome>`…
Approval context: One decision worth a tap before the coder builds: this gate BLOCKS the send rather than warning. A blocking gate on the send path can wedge a ticket if a stale parcel is left in some role's mailbox — which is why the refusal is required to name the command that clears it.
